title: Greek Lyric Poetry: A Commentary on Selected Larger Pieces
author: Hutchinson, G. O.
subject: Greek lyric poetry; classics; classical studies; ancient Greek literature; commentary; Alcman; Stesichorus; Sappho; Alcaeus; Ibycus; Anacreon; Simonides; Bacchylides; Pindar; Sophocles; Euripides; papyrology; textual criticism; Oxford University Press
description: Oxford University Press paperback issue (2003) of Hutchinson's commentary on the major pieces of Greek lyric, from Alcman to Simonides, with a large poem each from Bacchylides and Pindar and two odes from tragedy. Trade paperback in the publisher's glossy pictorial wrappers; no dust jacket, as issued. A very good copy: wrappers rubbed and lightly scratched overall, corners bumped and creased, small nicks to the spine ends and a light crease to the front joint. The spine is uncracked and the binding tight; the text block is clean, white and square, but there are pencil markings in the text and a pencilled list of page references, partly struck through, on the front blank leaf.
